questions.q: The famous statue of the Yoruba god of thunder, 'Sango', was created by which renowned pioneer artist?
questions.explain: The iconic bronze statue of 'Sango', holding his traditional double-headed axe, was sculpted by the renowned Nigerian artist Ben Enwonwu.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Nigerian Art Heritage & Pioneers

questions.topic: Prominent Art Works and their Locations

questions.q: According to the BECE syllabus, where is Ben Enwonwu's prominent 'Sango' statue located?
questions.explain: Ben Enwonwu's 'Sango' statue is prominently located at the Power Holding Company of Nigeria (PHCN, formerly NEPA) headquarters in Marina, Lagos, serving as a symbol of electrical power (thunder).
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Nigerian Art Heritage & Pioneers

questions.topic: Prominent Art Works and their Locations

questions.q: Which Nigerian artist is recognized for creating the sculptural decorations found at the National Theatre in Lagos?
questions.explain: According to the syllabus, the prominent sculptural decorations at the National Theatre, Lagos, are attributed to Demas Nwoko, a multi-talented Nigerian artist, designer, and architect.

questions.q: The location of the National Theatre, which features Demas Nwoko's sculptural decorations, is in which state?
questions.explain: The National Arts Theatre is an iconic cultural landmark located in Iganmu, Lagos State.

questions.q: According to the syllabus, Bruce Onabrakpeya's famous etching works and artistic center are historically associated with which location?
questions.explain: The BECE syllabus links Bruce Onabrakpeya's etching works to Agbanafor (properly known as Agbarha-Otor) in Delta State, where he established the Harmattan Workshop and his gallery.

questions.q: Ben Enwonwu's famous 'Anyanwu' and 'Sango' statues serve to illustrate the successful blending of:
options: European portrait painting and African textiles
Modern sculptural techniques and traditional Nigerian cultural themes
Digital graphic design and traditional weaving
questions.explain: Ben Enwonwu famously combined formal Western art training (techniques like bronze modeling) with indigenous Nigerian subjects, myths, and aesthetics, paving the way for contemporary Nigerian art.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Nigerian Art Heritage & Pioneers

questions.topic: Prominent Art Works and their Locations

questions.q: Which famous Nigerian contemporary artist painted 'Tutu', an iconic portrait of a Yoruba princess often referred to as the 'African Mona Lisa'?
questions.explain: Ben Enwonwu painted 'Tutu', a masterpiece portrait of Adetutu Ademiluyi, an Ife princess. The painting gained legendary status and was later discovered in a London flat after being missing for decades.

questions.q: Where is Ben Enwonwu's imposing statue of the traditional thunder god 'Sango' located in Nigeria?
options: At the entrance of the National Assembly, Abuja
At the University of Ibadan Library
At the PHCN (formerly NEPA) headquarters in Lagos
questions.explain: According to standard art curriculum, Ben Enwonwu's bronze 'Sango' statue (representing the god of thunder and electricity) sits outside the PHCN (Power Holding Company of Nigeria) building in Marina, Lagos.

questions.q: Demas Nwoko is celebrated for his unique approach that blends modern architecture with indigenous Nigerian arts. Which major national landmark features his notable sculptural decorations?
options: The National Theatre in Iganmu, Lagos
The Central Bank of Nigeria building, Abuja
questions.explain: Demas Nwoko created the impressive sculptural decorations and wood carvings incorporated into the design of the National Arts Theatre in Lagos.

questions.q: According to the recommended BECE curriculum, Bruce Onabrakpeya’s prominent center for etching and artistic workshops (the Harmattan Workshop) is situated in:
questions.explain: Bruce Onabrakpeya established the Ovuomaroro Studio and the annual Harmattan Workshop in his hometown of Agbarha-Otor (referred to as Agbanafor in some syllabi), Delta State.

questions.q: Ben Enwonwu sculpted a famous bronze statue titled 'Anyanwu' (The Awakening), which is a symbol of an emerging nation. Where is a prominent version of this sculpture located globally?
options: At the Louvre Museum in Paris
At the United Nations Headquarters in New York
Inside the British Museum in London
At the White House in Washington D.C.
questions.explain: A prominent casting of Ben Enwonwu's 'Anyanwu' was presented as a gift from Nigeria to the United Nations and is located at the UN Headquarters in New York (another exists at the National Museum in Lagos).

questions.q: Which renowned Nigerian artist sculpted the massive carved wooden doors that can be seen at the University of Ibadan and the Catholic Chapel of the same university?
questions.explain: Lamidi Fakeye executed numerous monumental public commissions in wood, including the intricately carved doors at the Institute of African Studies and the Catholic Chapel at the University of Ibadan.
